findings.evidence: First section uses "one step bolder and larger than the field label" while checkout and profile settings sections use "bold text set larger than the field label"
findings.fix: Standardize the terminology across all messages - use either "one step bolder and larger" or "bold text set larger" throughout the document, or clarify in a note if the first section's signals are intentionally styled differently.
findings.location: Signup form section, signal field for first message vs. all other sections
findings.violation: Terminology for describing signal strength is inconsistent across the document, making it unclear whether these are intentionally different visual treatments or simply inconsistent language.
